sections.section: RULE - Sindh Local Government Nazims, Naib Nazims and Members (Honoraria and Privileges) Rules 2001
sections.description:
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT NAZIMS, NAIB NAZIMS AND MEMBERS (HONORARIA AND
PRIVILEGES) RULES, 2001
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT NAZIMS, NAIB NAZIMS AND MEMBERS (HONORARIA AND PRIVILEGES) RULES,
2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 5th December, 2001]
No.SLGB/CAO/2001/7481, dated 5‑12‑2001.‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred under section 191 of Sindh Local Government
Ordinance, 2001 the Government of Sindh is pleased to make the following Rules:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) These rules may be called the Sindh Local
Government Nazims, Naib Nazims and Members, (Honoraria and Privileges) Rules,
2001.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Honoraria.‑‑‑A
Nazim shall be paid honorarium at the following rate: ‑‑
(i)
Twenty‑five thousand rupees per mensem in the case of city district.
(ii)
Twenty thousand rupees per mensem in the case of districts other than city district.
(iii)
A Taluka or town Nazim shall be paid honorarium at the rate of fifteen thousand per mensem.
3. House Rent.‑‑All
Zila Nazims shall be entitled for official residential accommodation subject to
being the property of concerned Local Government and in case the same is not
available/utilized the following shall be admissible in lieu thereof.
(i)
The Zila Nazim shall be paid house rent equal to 45% of the honorarium in case of Karachi, Hyderabad and Sukkur Districts.
(ii)
30% in case of other districts.
4. Use of official Vehicle.‑A
Zila and Taluka/Town Nazim shall be entitled to the use of official vehicle
maintained at the concerned Local Government's expenses, allocated for the
purpose in the budget, subject to the limitations as may be determined by
respective councils and general policy guidelines from Government.
5. T.A. and D.A.‑‑Zila,
Taluka/Town and Union Nazims or Naib Nazims of all Zila, Taluka/Town and Union
travelling on duty, shall be entitled, subject to availability of a provision
in the budget to Travelling and Daily allowance as are admissible to officers
of the B.S. indicated against each:‑‑
(i) Zila Nazim, City District
BS‑21
(ii) Zila Nazim (other
districts) and Naib Nazim, City District Government Karachi
BS‑20
(iii) Town Nazims, of City
District and Taluka Nazims of Hyderabad/Larkana, Sukkur and Mirpurkhas TMA's.
BS‑19
(iv) Taluka Nazims of all
District Headquarters.
BS‑18
(v) Taluka Nazims of TMAs other
than above and all Union Nazims.
BS‑17
6. Daily Allowance to Members
for attending meetings.‑‑(a) For attending meetings of City
District/District Government Rs.300 per day.
(b)
For attending meetings of Taluka/Town Council Rs.200 per day.
(c)
Members will be allowed air fare if called to attend official meetings/training
course out side the province in
additional to the above DA.
(i)
The respective council shall be the controlling authority adjudicating TA and DA of Nazim/Naib Nazims and other members of
the council proceeding on training and
official meeting etc.
(ii)
The respective Nazim shall be the controlling officer for the purpose of TA and DA of officers.
7. Telephone.‑‑(i)
A Zila Nazim shall be entitled to the facility of one STD telephone at his
residence and two STD telephones, including telephone connection for fax
machine at his office at the expense of Local Government up to the limit fixed
by the respective council.
(ii) Naib Zila/Taluka/Town Nazim
as the case may be, shall be entitled to the facility of one STD telephone at
his office at the expense of council up to the limit fixed by the council.
8. Medical Facility.‑‑A
Zila Nazim shall be entitled to medical facilities subject to rules/policy
prescribed by Government.
9. Office Accommodation and staff.‑‑A
Zila Nazim, Naib Nazim, Taluka, Town Nazim, Naib Town/Taluka Nazim and Union
Nazim shall be entitled to office accommodation within the precincts of
Council/Administration. He shall also be entitled to such office personal staff
as approved in the respective schedule of establishment.
